page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs with 4 physical cores and 1.0 thread per core, supported by 16.0 GB of system memory. A key architectural feature is the inclusion of a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU with a 0.0833 allocation, providing 2 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance does not include local storage and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations place the instance's CPU performance in the average tier, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1554.0 and a multi-core score of 5066.0. Stress-ng tests yield 1904.08 for single-core and 7176.28 for multi-core operations. However, memory performance exhibits limitations; the Passmark memory score falls into the bottom 25% tier, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression is rated in the bottom 10% with a throughput of 21.1 GB/sec. Conversely, the instance demonstrates solid capabilities in specific workloads, achieving 8.23 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and 9.28 GB/sec in static web serving.

Given its fractional GPU allocation and lack of local storage, this instance offers a cost-efficient entry point for workloads requiring light GPU acceleration without the expense of a full dedicated GPU. The 2 GB of VRAM and 4 vCPUs make it suitable for entry-level virtual workstations, lightweight image processing, and small-scale LLM inference, where it processes 135M model prompts at 411.88 tokens per second. It is less suitable for memory-intensive databases or heavy multi-threaded decompression tasks due to its lower memory performance and database benchmark scores.
